title: Wave 2: Settings, site against mount, command palette, support bundle (after the review)
summary: Wave 2 of web/spec/README.md section 7 after its design and technical reviews were applied. The Settings screen with its nine categories, generated from the server's config meta (every key of 02 appendix A editable or read-only with its reason), live sync between clients, Undo, the in-app FilePicker; the site-against-mount check; the Help menu, About, the support bundle; the command palette. Review fixes visible here: the palette runs the row it highlights; the observer's name, AAVSO code and site have no Reset (no default: 0°, 0° is not a site); Observer & site fits 1 440 × 900 (one Position row, one line of help where the help column shows it); controls sized by content, rules between groups only, a small dot for 'changed', Reset on hover or focus; one Attention mark for the site mismatch everywhere and no brass-looking frame; refusals never cut; U+202F grouping and one range notation ('−90° … +90°'); help in the observer's words, Qt-only keys folded away; Comfortable density changes card values, statistics and log lines; Slew brass only for a new target; paths with a middle cut; key hints on the rail, filter, Help and palette; the FilePicker without a brass region ring. Taken against the ARGOS server with the simulator and a temporary configuration, HOME and sessions folder, in headless Chrome; the Settings site is Berkeley while the simulator mount sits at APC Paris. 1 440 × 900 in Observatory, Charcoal and Night Red, 1 280 × 800 in Observatory. The Night Red shots pass scripts/audit-png.mjs (rules A and B, 0 px).

shots.caption: Settings › Observer & site with the site-against-mount check failing, the 2026-09-25 case reproduced: the simulator mount points at RR Lyr from its own site (APC, Paris) while the Settings site is Berkeley. The panel gives the verdict in one bold sentence, both altitudes and azimuths (2 decimals), the angle between the directions against the 5° limit, when it was checked and the mount's own site 8 941 km away. One alert vocabulary: the upright Attention mark (bar over a dot) on the chip, the intro line, the category list, the rail's Settings entry and the status bar; a 3 px warning bar instead of a brass-looking frame. The site is one Position row (latitude, longitude, elevation side by side); the observer's values have no Reset (no shipped default: 0°, 0° is not a site). The page fits 1 440 × 900 without scrolling. (observatory, 1440x900.)
